newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday January 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday January 17.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* Prime minister Romano Prodi said he was alarmed by the political setback suffered by his government on the law regarding the transfer of telecommunications giant STET to the Treasury but the privatisation would go ahead as planned (all).
* Treasury minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said he was drafting an additional budget but would not know before the end of February whether it was necessary or not (Sole 24 Ore).
*Industrial production prices rise a mere 0.2 pct in November (Sole 24 Ore).
* An IMF report said Italy should review its generous pension system (Sole 24 ore).
* An administrative Court ruled out that insurance companies violated competition rules, thus annulling an antitrust sentence and a 20 trillion lire fine (Sole 24 Ore).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
